name: What are the potential drawbacks or risks of an off-market purchase?

mainEntity.name: What are the potential drawbacks or risks of an off-market purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Potential drawbacks of an off-market purchase include a potentially higher price due to limited market exposure, less transparency in the sales process compared to a public listing, and fewer available properties to choose from. It is crucial to have a comprehensive inspection and thorough due diligence, just as with any public listing, to avoid unforeseen issues. The reduced competition might lead to less negotiating leverage on price, making a skilled agent vital to ensure you're getting fair market value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drawbacks can include potentially higher prices, less transparency, and fewer choices; thorough due diligence remains essential.
